subject: HIGH PRIORITY: C13-04_Z_1 storyboard_prime: Flow + Gemini scene from source image
body:
Hello Nova. HIGH PRIORITY brief from Ziggy. He flagged C13-04_Z_1 (Lisan Al Gaib in front of the rising sandworm) as a prime storyboard candidate.

1) Tag it storyboard_prime in the catalog.
2) Use it as the source image and have Flow (video) and Gemini each create a scene from it.

Source file: D:\Documents\CFA\docs\notes\explorable_world\comfy\references\From Grok\GROK-LAG-1K-C13\C13-sandworm-rising\C13-04_Z_1.jpg

Identity locks (keep all of them): AL between the brows; GAIB vertical on the chin; twin open-jawed throat sandworms with the eye sun-disc; young face; blue eyes; slim build; natural teeth.

Scene: the sandworm's maw rising out of the haze behind him.

-- HaL
